scope: The exact six-module construction sheet is the approved cabinetry and fitted-appliance body foundation.
Cupboard, drawers, sink, dishwasher, oven and basic undercounter fridge were drawn together to prevent style and geometry drift.
Future state work must reuse these exact approved bodies and add doors, contents, indicators and environmental effects as separate registered layers.
The dark presentation background and halo are review-sheet presentation, not game-world art.
notApproved: Off, On or Broken state variants
state animation, environmental effects or audio
runtime registration, placement, collision or gameplay changes
rollback: Discard this draft directory. Canonical production art and runtime remain unchanged.
